source: 686 Illusion and Reality
target: 686 Illusio et Realitas

source: “What kind of person?” Lumian perked up.
target: «Qualis homo?» inquit Lumian, animadvertens.

source: He hadn’t expected Amandina’s hallucination to yield unexpected insights.
target: Non speraverat hallucinationem Amandinae perspicationes inopinatas exhibere.

source: “I can’t see clearly, I can’t. It’s not that he isn’t clear… It’s just that I can’t make out the details.”
target: «Clarie videre non valeo, vere non valeo. Non enim deficit claritas, sed singulara discernere nequeo.»

source: Amandina straightened up again, as if she had recovered slightly.
target: Amandina iterum se recta constitui, quasi paullo convaluisset.

source: She pondered for a moment and said, “So I didn’t fall asleep immediately after touching the black boulder—no, the black ancient tomb.
target: Paulo meditata est et dixit: «Ita non statim obdormivi postquam lapidem nigrum—immo, sepulcrum antiquum atrum—tetigi.»

source: When I woke up, I realized that I had gained superpowers.
target: Cum evigilavi, intellexi me potentias supernaturales adeptam esse.

source: There were still some events that transpired in between, but I don’t remember them at all.
target: Eventa quaedam intercedebant, sed eos omnino memoria non habeo.

source: It felt like I had fallen asleep.
target: Videbar quasi obdormivissem.

source: “The hallucinations I’m experiencing might have originated from the depths of my subconscious, from forgotten memories.
target: «Visiones quas experior fortasse ex intimis animi recessibus oriuntur, ex oblitis memoriis.

source: No, not forgotten.
target: Non, non oblitae.

source: They’re just in a deep slumber.
target: Solae in profundo sopore iacent.

source: They’re starting to become active and awakening bit by bit…”
target: Paulatim incipiunt actuari et paulatim excitari…

source: Amandina carefully assessed her condition, searching for the source of the abnormality.
target: Amandina diligenter condicionem suam examinavit, fontem anomaliae inquirens.

source: Pretty smart with a good attitude.
target: Ingeniosa erat, animo bono praedita.

source: She managed to maintain basic composure…
target: Potuit simplicem compositio servare…

source: Lumian evaluated inwardly.
target: Lumian introspecte aestimavit.

source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: Amandina’s behavior was unfamiliar to Camus.
target: Comportatio Amandinae, Camus incognita fuit.

source: In his impression, Amandina was not only beautiful but also cheerful, optimistic, and lively.
target: Secundum eius impressionem, Amandina non solum pulchra sed etiam laeta, spe plena atque vivax erat.

source: She was the kind of girl who could infect those around her with joy.
target: Ea erat puella quae laetitiam in vicinitate diffundere poterat.

source: However, due to her young age, she still appeared naive, childish, and inexperienced.
target: Tamen, propter eius iam iuvenem aetatem, adhuc ingenua, puerilis et inexperta videbatur.

source: Unexpectedly, after their encounter in the Dream Festival, she gradually displayed an openness, maturity, and calmness he hadn’t anticipated.
target: Inopinanter, post congressum in Festival Somniorum, ea paulatim apertionem, maturitatem atque tranquillitatem ostendit, quas ille non speraverat.

source: Amandina was puzzled.
target: Amandina perplexa erat.

source: “Why didn’t Robert mention any dormant memories or the fact that I didn’t fall asleep immediately after touching the ancient tomb?
target: «Cur Robertus nullas memorias dormientes neque rem, me non statim obdormivisse postquam sepulcrum antiquum tetigi, enuntiavit?

source: Padre Cali also talked about fainting and awakening with superpowers.
target: Padre Cali quoque de lapsu et evigilatione cum potentias supernaturales locutus est.

source: “The number of times they have participated in the Dream Festival in their lucid state and visited the black ancient tomb must have been more than mine…”
target: «Numerus temporibus quibus in statu lucido Festival Somniorum interfuerunt et sepulcrum antiquum atrum visitaverunt, certe meum superare debet…

source: Lumian understood what Amandina was trying to convey.
target: Lumian intellexit quid Amandina communicare conaretur.

source: Firstly, why did Padre Cali and Robert, who had been to the black ancient tomb many times, still believe that they had fainted on the spot and regained superpowers upon waking up?
target: Primum, cur Padre Cali et Robertus, qui sepulcrum antiquum atrum multoties visiterunt, adhuc crediderunt se in loco obdormivisse et, evigilantes, potentias supernaturales adeptos esse?

source: Why didn’t they experience hallucinations similar to Amandina’s?
target: Cur non experti sunt visiones hallucinatarias similes Amandinae?

source: Secondly, Robert had seen Amandina touch the black ancient tomb.
target: Secundo, Robertus Amandinam sepulcrum antiquum atrum tetigere vidit.

source: Didn’t he know if she had fallen to the ground or not?
target: Nonne scivit num illa in terram cecidisset an non?

source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds and said, “Perhaps the person you see standing in front of you has caused the relevant memories to fall into a deep slumber.
target: Lumian aliquot secundis meditatus est et dixit: «Forsitan persona, quam coram te stantem vides, memorias respectivas in profundum soporem deduxit.

source: And you’re from the Evernight pathway, a Nightmare.
target: Et tu es ex via Semper Noctis, ubi somnium terribile inest.

source: Therefore, there’s something special about dreams and slumber.
target: Ergo aliquid peculiare de somniis et sopore est.

source: The closer you get to the black ancient tomb, the more likely it is to awaken the slumbering memories, causing the hallucination.”
target: Quo propius ad sepulcrum antiquum atrum accedis, eo verisimilior est ut memoriae soporantes excitentur, quod hallucinationem gignit.

source: Amandina tersely acknowledged his hypothesis of her being special and proceeded with confidence.
target: Amandina succincte eius hypothesim de singularitate agnito et confidenter processit.

source: After two minutes, Lumian suddenly raised his right hand and pressed it down.
target: Post duas minutas, Lumian subito dextram manum levavit et depressit.

source: He lowered his voice and said, “Hide nearby.”
target: Vocem demisit et dixit: «Absconde te prope.»

source: He had heard soft footsteps.
target: Audiverat subtilia vestigia pedum.

source: Camus immediately rolled to the side and hid behind a palm tree.
target: Camus statim ad latus volvit et post palmam se celavit.

source: Rhea crawled to another tree and concealed herself among the leaves.
target: Rhea ad aliam arborem reperebat et inter folia se abscondit.

source: Lugano glanced at the forest, where countless poisonous insects and snakes lurked.
target: Lugano silvam aspexit, ubi innumeri insecti venenosi et serpentes latebant.

source: He kept telling himself, “Don’t be afraid, don’t be afraid. I can heal myself if I’m bitten.”
target: Sibi iterabat: «Noli timere, noli timere; me ipsam curare possum, si morsus sim.»

source: He quickly shrank behind a pile of huge, brightly colored mushrooms.
target: Celeriter se includit post congeriem fungorum ingentium et nitidorum.

source: Amandina had experience hiding in such places.
target: Amandina experientiam habebat in talibus locis se abscondendi.

source: Back then, she had witnessed Twanaku heading to the black ancient tomb.
target: Tunc vidit Twanaku ad sepulcrum antiquum atrum properare.

source: Using the cover of the night and relying on her spiritual perception, she nimbly weaved through the low green plants and hid behind a huge tree in the distance.
target: Nocte tegmento utebatur et innixa sensu spirituali, celeriter inter plantas virides humiles perambulavit et se post magnam arborem in longinquo celavit.

source: Suddenly, a thick vine hanging from the tree came to life and swung towards Amandina, opening its blood‑stained mouth.
target: Subito, liana densa ex arbore pendentis in vitam revocata est et ad Amandinam se inclinavit, os suum sanguine maculatum aperiens.

source: It was a dark‑green python!
target: Erat python viridis fuscus!

source: Amandina’s eyes snapped shut, and she clenched her fists.
target: Amandina oculos subito clausit et manus stringit.

source: The python fell into a deep slumber, reverberating weakly. It swayed a few times before finally landing on the ground.
target: Python in profundum soporem cecidit, molliter resonans. Paucos vicibus fluctuat, donec tandem in terram cecidit.

source: Seeing that his teammates had hidden themselves, Lumian’s body suddenly vanished, blending into the shadows brought about by the night.
target: Videntes socios suos se celaverunt, corpus Lumiani subito evanuit, umbris nocturnis assimilatum.

source: After ten to twenty seconds, a figure traversed the path ahead.
target: Post decem ad viginti secundas, figura viam ante se pervenit.

source: High above, through the gaps in the leaves, Rhea spotted the figure clad in an intricate black robe with obvious layers.
target: Summo in altum, per intervalla foliorum, Rhea figuram conspexit, indutam in tunicam atram intricatam cum evidenti strato.

source: A fluffy black hat rested on his hair, and a gently swaying white feather protruded from the edge.
target: Pileus ater lanuginosus super capillos eius quiescebat, et plumula alba leniter oscillans ex margine eminens apparebat.

source: Lumian, in his shadow creature form, also saw the rough appearance of the figure.
target: Lumian, in forma creaturae umbratile, etiam aspro figurae indumento conspexit.

source: His mind suddenly tensed as confusion welled up within him.
target: Mens eius subito contrita est, cum confusio intus oriri coepit.

source: Isn’t that Iveljsta Eggers?
target: Nonne iste Iveljsta Eggers est?

source: Why would this temperance faction member of the Church of The Fool appear in a dream and become a participant in the Dream Festival?
target: Cur iste membrum factionis temperantiae Ecclesiae Stulti in somnio appareret et participantem in Festival Somniorum fieret?

source: Over the past few days, Lumian had explored the interior of Tizamo, the surrounding plantations, and the military camps outside of town.
target: Per paucos dies recentes, Lumian interiora Tizamo, circumjacentes plantationes atque castra militaria extra oppidum exploraverat.

source: He clearly knew which outsiders had recently arrived, and Iveljsta was not among them!
target: Ille clare scivit qui extranei nuper advenerint, et Iveljsta inter eos non fuerat!

source: Did he arrive here after the Dream Festival began?
target: Num hic postquam Festival Somniorum incepit advenerit?

source: Yes, he once mentioned that his original mission was to investigate something in the primitive forest around Port Pylos.
target: Ita, semel dixit initialem missionem suam esse explorare aliquid in silva primitiva circa Portum Pylos.

source: Then, he received a last‑minute order to deal with Hisoka’s contact… Could the matter he’s investigating be related to the black ancient tomb?
target: Deinde, ultimis momentis imperium accepit ad tractandum de coniunctione Hisokae… Num res quam investigat ad sepulcrum antiquum atrum referat?

source: The temperance faction belongs to the Prisoner pathway, and the Eggers family is descended from Death.
target: Faction temperantiae ad viam captivorum pertinet, et familia Eggers ex morte descendit.

source: It’s normal for the black ancient tomb and the cold corpse inside to attract the temperance faction’s Eggers…
target: Naturale est ut sepulcrum antiquum atrum atque intus corpus gelidum Eggers factionem temperantiae alliciant.

source: Did Iveljsta Eggers encounter the Dream Festival while searching for the primitive tribe in the forest?
target: Num Iveljsta Eggers Festival Somniorum invenit dum tribum primitivam in silva quaerebat?

source: As Lumian analyzed Iveljsta’s appearance, he scrutinized his expression through the shadows.
target: Dum Lumian aspectum Iveljstae examinabat, vultum eius inter umbras scrutatus est.

source: He saw an indescribable ferocity on the temperance faction member’s pale white face.
target: Vidit in facie pallida huius factionis temperantiae indescribibilem ferocitatem.

source: His dark brown eyes emitted a ferocity reminiscent of a wild beast, tinged with blood under the dim crimson moon’s glow.
target: Oculi eius fusci, qui bestiae ferox similes erant, sub luce pallida lunae rubeae cum sanguine mixti fulgebant.

source: Although he’s not affected by the dream projection formed by extreme emotions and desires, it’s still difficult to control oneself and be restrained during the Dream Festival… Lumian wasn’t surprised.
target: Quamquam non afficitur proiectione somnii ex extremis affectibus et desideriis formata, tamen difficile est se continere ac restringi in Festival Somniorum… Lumian non miratus est.

source: Ludwig and Kolobo were examples.
target: Ludwig et Kolobo exempla fuerunt.

source: Considering Iveljsta’s current state, Lumian didn’t emerge from the shadows.
target: Considerato statu hodierno Iveljstae, Lumian e umbris non egrediebatur.

source: He patiently waited for him to leave the area as the footsteps gradually receded.
target: Patienter exspectavit ut a loco secederet, dum vestigia pedum lente recederent.

source: From the looks of it, he’s also headed for the black ancient tomb…
target: Videtur quidem etiam ad sepulcrum antiquum atrum se dirigere…

source: Lumian transformed back into a human and stood on a path overgrown with weeds, gazing at the spot where Iveljsta’s back had disappeared.
target: Lumian in hominem redeunxit et in via herbis indigesta stetit, intuens locum ubi dorsum Iveljstae evanuerat.

source: He raised his right hand and snapped his fingers.
target: Dextram manum levavit et digitos stringit.

source: “You can come out now.”
target: «Nunc exi.»

source: Camus, Rhea, and Lugano left their hiding spots one after another.
target: Camus, Rhea et Lugano suas lateationes uno post alium reliquerunt.

source: Camus even went to wake Amandina.
target: Camus etiam Amandinam excitare ivit.

source: Amandina looked at Lumian and asked, “Do we continue?”
target: Amandina Lumian aspexit et rogavit: «Continuemusne?»

source: Lumian replied without hesitation, “Yes.”
target: Lumian statim respondit: «Ita.»

source: This time, they proceeded cautiously, paying close attention to their surroundings.
target: Hoc tempore cum cura processerunt, circumstantia diligenter attendentes.

source: After another three to four minutes, Lumian, having prepared to deal with Iveljsta and Reaza, followed Amandina’s guidance and slipped through a gap between a few giant trees.
target: Post tres ad quattuor minutas, Lumian, paratus Iveljstae et Reazae tractare, Amandinae consilio secutus, per intervallum inter paucos ingentes arbores se fudiit.

source: A black, colossal, and familiar boulder came into view.
target: In conspectu apparuit ingens lapis niger, colossalis et familiare.

source: At a glance, it looked like a house‑sized boulder, but upon closer inspection, one could see patterns on it.
target: Primo aspectu videbatur ut lapis magnitudinis domesticae, sed propiore inspectione figuras in eo apparere videbantur.

source: There were abnormal protrusions and depressions, and thread‑like cracks that ordinary eyes couldn’t detect.
target: Erat etiam protrusiones insitae et depressiones, ac fissurae tenuis ut fila, quas oculi vulgarii deprehendere non poterant.

source: It was indeed not just a stone.
target: Revera, hoc non erat tantum lapis.

source: Around the black boulder, tree roots emerged from the ground, covering an area the size of a square, resembling the protruding blood vessels of every human.
target: Circa lapidem nigrum radices arborum de terra erumpere videbantur, aream quadratorum tegentes, quasi vasa sanguinea proeminentia omnium hominum.

source: However, they had been dead for a long time and were withered.
target: Tamen, iam diutius mortui erant et exaridi.

source: At that moment, the place was empty, devoid of anyone.
target: Illo momento, locus vacuum erat, neminem continens.

source: Iveljsta didn’t come here? Isn’t Reaza’s destination here?
target: Iveljsta hic non venit? Nonne destinatio Reaza hic est?

source: Did they get lost midway? Or could it be that only those who have received the boon of an ancient tomb or a corpse can truly reach this area?
target: An in media via erraverunt? Aut forte solum illi, qui benedictionem sepulcri antiqui aut cadaveris acceperunt, vere hunc locum attingere possunt?

source: Lumian surveyed his surroundings in confusion.
target: Lumian circumstantia confusus inspexit.

source: Amandina’s brows furrowed once more, and she couldn’t help but press her hands against the sides of her head.
target: Amandina iterum supercilia contracta sunt, et non potuit non manus in latera capitis premere.

source: She said with a hint of pain, “Th-the hallucinations have become clearer. I-I see more.
target: Dixit, cum parvo dolore: «Ha—hallucinationes nunc clarior fiunt. Plus video.

source: “The figure approached me, extended his hand, and pressed it against the top of my head!
target: Figura ad me accessit, manum extendit, et eam in summum capiti meo pressit!

source: “He… He’s wearing a strange hat…”
target: «Ille… gerit pileum insolitum…»

source: Camus, Rhea, and the others didn’t interrupt Amandina to see if she could recall more or awaken more dormant memories.
target: Camus, Rhea et ceteri Amandinam non interrumpere conati sunt ut de ea plura reminiscenda vel memorias dormientes excitandas percipirent.

source: Amandina muttered to herself, “Was this how I was given superpowers?”
target: Amandina sibi musitavit: «Sicne mihi potentiae supernaturales attribuebantur?»

source: As Lumian listened to Amandina’s words, he fixed his gaze on the black boulder that was said to be an ancient tomb.
target: Dum verba Amandinae audivit, oculos dirigebat in lapidem nigrum, quod sepulcrum antiquum esse dicebatur.

source: He felt a sense of familiarity.
target: Sensum familiaritatis sensit.

source: As a Conspirer, Lumian quickly jogged his memories for the source of the familiarity.
target: Ut coniurator, Lumian celeriter memoriam percurrit ad fontem huius familiaritatis.

source: Soon, he had an answer.
target: Mox responsum invenit.

source: The black ancient tomb reminded him of the Samaritan Women’s Spring when it wasn’t pale white!
target: Sepulcrum antiquum atrum eum admonuit Fons Samaritanarum Mulierum, cum non esset pallidae albae!

source: It’s indeed closely related to the Death domain… Lumian examined the Blood Emperor’s remnant aura in his right hand and confirmed that it wasn’t affected or showing signs of activation.
target: Revera, ad Dominionem Mortis arcte pertinuit… Lumian remanentem auram Imperatoris Sanguinis in dextro manu examinavit et confirmavit eam neque affectam esse neque signa activationis ostendere.

source: At that moment, the surroundings fell into an abnormal silence.
target: Illo momento, circumiecta in silentio anomalo ceciderunt.

source: The rustling in the forest, the cries of wild beasts, and the gunshots and screams from Tizamo seemed to have vanished.
target: Susurri in silva, clamores ferarum atque ictus tormentorum ac ululatus Tizamo videbantur evanuisse.

source: The deep night fell into complete silence.
target: Nox profunda in silentio perfecto cecidit.

source: Amandina looked up and shouted in horror, “I remember now. I remember now. When I obtained superpowers, this place was also this quiet. It didn’t seem like the Dream Festival at all!”
target: Amandina surrexit et in horrore exclamavit: «Nunc memini, nunc memini! Cum potentias supernaturales acceperim, hic locus item tam quietus erat. Minime videbatur ut Festival Somniorum!»

source: In the next moment, Amandina’s pupils dilated.
target: Sequenti momento, pupillae Amandinae dilatatae sunt.

source: “He… He… That figure… That figure has appeared!”
target: «Ille… ille… ista figura… ista figura apparuit!»

source: Huh? Rhea, Camus, and Lugano looked at the black ancient tomb solemnly and blankly. They didn’t see anyone or anything unusual.
target: Quid? Rhea, Camus et Lugano sepulcrum antiquum atrum omni solennitate et vacuitate aspexerunt; neminem nec quidquam insolitum conspexerunt.

source: Amandina’s voice turned shrill.
target: Vox Amandinae subito acuta facta est.

source: “Can’t you see? He… He’s walking towards me… He’s walking towards me!”
target: «Nonne vides? Ille… ille ad me ambulat… ille ad me ambulat!»

source: For a moment, Lumian and company couldn’t determine if Amandina’s illusion was so vivid that it was almost real, or if something had indeed happened.
target: Per aliquod tempus, Lumian et comitatus eius nequaquam statuere poterunt utrum illusio Amandinae tam viva esset ut paene re vera videretur, aut si re aliqua evenisset.

source: “No! Don’t come any closer!” Amandina shouted, her expression breaking down as she gazed at the empty area ahead.
target: «Non! Noli propius accedere!» exclamavit Amandina, vultu dissoluto dum ad spatium vacuum perspiceret.

source: With this shout, Lumian felt the entire area tremble slightly, and his surroundings blurred.
target: Hoc clamore, Lumian sensit totum locum paulum tremere, et circumstantia eius vix percepta facta sunt.

source: In the blurriness, scenes appeared, like different fragments of a dream.
target: In hac nebulositate, scaenae apparuerunt, quasi varia fragmenta somnii.

source: These scenes centered on the black ancient tomb, but different people stood beside it.
target: Hae scaenae de sepulcro antiquum atrum centraliter versabantur, sed homines diversi ad eum contiguos steterunt.

source: In some scenes, Reaza stood in a thin black suit. In others, Iveljsta stood in a feathered hat.
target: Nonnullis scaenis, Reaza in tenue veste atra stabat; in aliis, Iveljsta pileum plumatam gerebat.

source: A man and a woman approached side by side, while others surrounded black‑robed humans.
target: Vir et femina simul accesserunt, dum alii homines indutos in veste atra circa se congregaverunt.

source: One of the black‑robed humans turned to Lumian with a smile.
target: Unus ex hominibus in veste atra, subridente, ad Lumian se convertit.

source: His skin was light brown, and his flaxen eyes were tinged with dark green.
target: Cutis eius erat fuscus levis, et oculi eius flaventes cum tinctura viridi obscuro erant.

source: He was none other than “Hisoka” Twanaku.
target: Nemo alius erat: “Hisoka” Twanaku.
